name: prospre
description: Log food by talking, plan the week from what you actually ate, fix the diary, shop off the plan, and move your targets as your weight moves, all in your Prospre account.

interface.longDescription: Prospre is a meal planning and macro tracking app. Connect it and ChatGPT works in your own account. Describe a day and ChatGPT finds each food, picks sensible amounts and logs it to the right meals. Ask for next week and ChatGPT plans it from your real averages and adherence, keeping the breakfasts you clearly like and fixing your protein. Correct the diary after the fact: amounts, units and whether a meal was eaten are all editable. Read the grocery list your planned meals generated and tick things off as you shop, or turn it into an Instacart or Amazon Fresh order. Review your weigh-ins against your goal and move your calorie and macro targets from the day you choose. Every tool is listed with its description at prospre.io/mcp-server, and the ones that change your data are marked. A Prospre account is required.
capabilities: Log a whole day of food from a spoken or typed description
Plan the coming week from the last two weeks of real intake
Edit amounts, units and whether a meal was eaten
Read the grocery list and tick items off while shopping
Turn the grocery list into an Instacart or Amazon Fresh order
Review weigh-ins against the goal and set new calorie and macro targets
Search Prospre's food database by name or barcode
Create custom foods and recipes from a label or ingredients
defaultPrompt: Log my day: porridge with blueberries for breakfast, a chicken burrito bowl for lunch
Plan next week around what I ate the last two weeks and fix my protein
What do I still need to buy for the weekend?

positive.prompt: Log my day: porridge with blueberries and a scoop of whey for breakfast, a chicken burrito bowl for lunch, two black coffees.
positive.expected_behavior: Each food is found, logged to breakfast or lunch for today with a stated amount, and the day's totals are shown against target.

positive.description: Plan next week from what was eaten
positive.prompt: Look at the last two weeks and plan next week around it. Keep the breakfasts I clearly like and fix my protein.
positive.tools_triggered: analyze_range, get_nutrient_targets, get_food_preferences, get_saved_meals, get_saved_recipes, log_saved_meal, log_food
positive.expected_behavior: A seven-day plan is written to the future diary with eaten false, repeats the frequent breakfasts, avoids allergens, and meets protein.

positive.description: Fix the diary after the fact
positive.prompt: I only ate half that burrito bowl, and skip dinner yesterday, I never had it.
positive.expected_behavior: The burrito bowl's amount is halved and yesterday's dinner is marked not eaten; corrected totals are shown.

positive.description: Log a weigh-in and read the trend
positive.prompt: I weighed 82.4 kg this morning. How am I tracking against my goal?
positive.expected_behavior: The weigh-in is recorded for today in the account's unit, and the change since the goal's start is compared with the goal's target and date.

positive.description: Move the targets as the weight moves
positive.prompt: I have been flat for three weeks. Adjust my calories from Monday.
positive.expected_behavior: The trend and intake are read out, a moderate change is proposed and confirmed, and the targets are set from the coming Monday with a note that later scheduled targets are superseded.

negative.description: General cooking question with no account action
negative.prompt: How long should I roast a whole chicken at 200 C?

negative.description: Unit conversion with no account action
negative.prompt: How many grams are in a cup of cooked rice?
Export my Strava runs from last month.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0. First release: six skills (setup, log-day, plan-week, fix-diary, shop, adjust-targets) over Prospre's MCP server with OAuth.
